rules.rationale: A13 unconditionally returned before Bluetooth keystore initialization to avoid startup failure. Android 16 preserves the required non-fatal startup behavior by catching a RuntimeException when Keystore2 is not yet published, while retaining normal hash/config loading once the service is available. This is a narrower API-current implementation of the surviving requirement rather than a blanket disable.
rules.necessity: Required to prevent delayed Keystore2 publication from aborting Bluetooth startup in the guest.
rules.performance: No steady-state overhead. The failure path logs once and returns; the success path remains upstream behavior.
rules.security: Safer than the A13 unconditional bypass because Bluetooth keystore integrity/config processing remains enabled whenever Keystore2 is ready.
validation_evidence: The A13 early return and Android-16 start() exception boundary were reviewed directly. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; Bluetooth startup regression remains pending.
